tools.name: enroll_target
tools.description: Start authorization and origin-control proof for up to five exact read-only HTTPS GET paths. Serve the returned proof JSON at proof_url before verifying. Private read_token must be generated and saved by the caller.

tools.name: verify_target
tools.description: Verify the exact proof file for a previously started enrollment. Successful enrollment expires after 24 hours.

tools.name: verify_deployment
tools.description: Return a $0.01 native Base USDC x402 challenge without paying. For execution supply a verified enrollment, private read token, idempotency key and caller-created payment_signature or headers.PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. Only that payment header is accepted; enrollment/read token/idempotency remain explicit. N

tools.name: preflight_pack
tools.description: Free configuration and enrollment preflight before paying. Validates exact authorized paths, pack and idempotency format; refuses an existing caller payment attempt. Makes no target request, signature, settlement or ledger write. Not a deployment test, wallet/balance check or capacity reservation.

tools.name: read_report
tools.description: Read or reconcile the original private report for a purchase. Use the ORIGINAL idempotency_key, not the report_id UUID. Free; never signs or charges. If state is uncertain do not pay again. Requires the original private read token; reports expire after seven days.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "enroll_target" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
